sections.title: A digital palette can come with an in-person session
sections.html:
If you are searching in Portland, Maine, check the South Portland location and distinguish color analysis from a full wardrobe service. Also avoid a false choice between “digital” and “in person”: a consultant may provide a digital palette after a live session, while an app provides its own photo-based analysis and tools.

True Colors Maine

True Colors Maine lists color analysis in South Portland at US$125 for 90 minutes, with draping, makeup application and a digital palette. Its style consultation, closet audit and personal-shopping services are separate listings with separate fees.

sections.title: Before booking in Portland
sections.html:
Ask how the digital palette is delivered, whether you can keep it without an ongoing payment, and what advice is included for clothing combinations. If you also want help editing your closet, get that service quoted separately. A 90-minute consultation does not automatically include a home visit or a shopping trip.

  • How do I access and keep the digital palette after the appointment?
  • Are closet editing or shopping visits included or separately billed?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Use the result to plan one outfit for an ordinary day before tackling a whole wardrobe. Compare a neutral, an accent and a lip color you already own. The app can help you explore alternatives on your phone; the live session gives you an opportunity to ask about actual drapes and makeup. Choose the mix that solves your problem rather than paying twice for a digital palette alone.
